text:
ashley: FYI customer FlickerAI getting intermittent 504s from hosted inference this morning. p95 tail timeouts rising to ~12s. sample request_id=rcq-7f2a9b. Can eng help triage? :eyes:

matt: thanks — can you paste a sample request + headers (tenant id, model) and the timeframe? any recent deploys?

ashley: quick details: tenant=flicker-prod, model=redwood-std-1, timeframe=1765012200-1765012400. No deploys from our side that I know of. curl sample: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxxx" -H "X-Tenant: flicker-prod" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate```

eng-alert: alert: hosted-gateway queue_depth > 95% (gpu-us-west-2-1) at 1765012250. p95_enqueue_time_ms=2400, p99_enqueue_time_ms=8900.

john: saw the alert. continuous-batcher backlog jumped after small tenant spike. dequeue rate dropped due to one slower worker (OOM-ish GC pauses). queue depth hit configured cap (1024) and early-reject didn't trigger fast enough. Logs show many requests waiting in queue >5s.

matt: interesting — if a worker GC pauses, KV cache rebuild can amplify per-request latency because cache warmups serialize. can you grab tracer for one of the slow request_ids? also paste batcher stack dumps for 1765012240-1765012280.

sarah: I have the customer's repro steps. They run 200 concurrent short requests (avg tokens 60) which normally batch efficiently. Repro curl (from customer): ```for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer ${KEY}" -d '{"prompt":"test"}' & done; wait``` They hit 504s after ~30s. Customer asked for mitigation asap.

matt: quick mitigations we can try: 1) route flicker-prod to fallback smaller-batch config (max_batch_tokens=512, max_batch_size=16) 2) temporarily enable aggressive early-reject threshold at 800 queue depth 3) restart the one worker to clear KV-warmup tail. Which is fastest?

ev an: customer comms: we should offer a short-term mitigation + ETA. Sarah can we ask them to toggle retries/backoff while we run mitigation?

ashley: pinged customer asking them to pause high-concurrency repros and we offered to route them. they agreed to short pause.

john: I'm scheduling a rolling restart of gpu-us-west-2-1 worker-07 now, will monitor queue depth. also bumping early-reject to 800 on that pool.

oncall-bot: running rolling-restart worker-07 (gpu-us-west-2-1) — started 1765012350.

matt: after restart, check batcher metrics: batchization latency, avg batch size, and kv_cache_warmup_rate. Also add a debug flag to emit per-tenant enqueue_time_ms histograms for next 15m.

oncall-bot: restart complete 1765012405. worker-07 rejoined.

john: post-restart metrics: queue depth back to normal (~120), p95_enqueue_time_ms down to 180ms. No customer 504s in last 3m. Looks like GC/warmup tail was the trigger.

sarah: updated FlickerAI: "We've routed you to a smaller-batch config and restarted an affected worker; you should see improved latency. Please resume tests gradually and let us know if 504s persist." customer replied :thumbsup:.

matt: follow-ups: 1) add guardrail: detect sustained per-worker GC pauses and trigger eviction/fallback earlier 2) investigate KV cache rebuild path to avoid blocking dequeue 3) consider lowering default early-reject threshold or making it adaptive by pool.

ev an: please add a short postmortem note and customer-facing timeline. I'll draft comms once we have root-cause and next-steps.

ashley: adding the quick repro + logs to this thread for postmortem. key logs: "enqueue_time_ms=2530 tenant=flicker-prod request_id=rcq-7f2a9b pool=gpu-us-west-2-1" and batcher trace snippet: ```[batcher] waiting_for_batch: queue_len=1012, avg_batch_size=48, dequeue_latency_ms=5200```

matt: thanks — I pushed a small config change to make early-reject adaptive by observing dequeue_latency. will monitor for 30m.

oncall-bot: config change applied to pool gpu-us-west-2-1 at 1765012500.

john: monitoring shows stable queues. I'll follow up with a more detailed write-up and recommended config defaults for continuous-batcher.

sarah: customer confirmed no new 504s after 20 minutes. closing loop with them now.

ashley: good job team. will capture timeline and attach to support ticket.
